DayMission.description: Learn basic German greetings, goodbyes, and polite expressions.

NightMission.description: Learn to say your name, where you are from, and ask someone's name.

DayMission.description: Learn German numbers from 1 to 20 and talk about age.

NightMission.description: Practice asking and answering simple questions about age, name, and nationality.

DayMission.description: Learn common German words for family members and relationships.

NightMission.description: Build simple sentences describing your family.

DayMission.description: Learn common German vocabulary for food, drinks, and meals.

NightMission.description: Practice ordering food and drinks at a German restaurant or cafe.

DayMission.description: Learn common German verbs and vocabulary for everyday activities.

NightMission.description: Describe your daily routine using simple German sentences.

DayMission.description: Learn days of the week, common time expressions, and how to tell the time.

NightMission.description: Practice talking about when you are free and making simple plans.

DayMission.description: Learn vocabulary for common places and basic direction words.

NightMission.description: Practice asking for and giving simple directions in German.

DayMission.description: Learn German vocabulary for shops, prices, clothes, and common products.

NightMission.description: Practice asking prices, choosing products, and making a purchase.

DayMission.description: Learn basic German sentence structure and the position of verbs.

NightMission.description: Practice forming simple questions and answering them naturally.

DayMission.description: Review the vocabulary and grammar learned during the first nine days.

NightMission.description: Complete a short conversation using greetings, introductions, numbers, family, food, time, and everyday expressions.

DayMission.description: Learn German vocabulary for rooms, furniture, and objects around the home.

NightMission.description: Practice describing your home and where things are located.

DayMission.description: Learn vocabulary for hobbies, sports, music, and free-time activities.

NightMission.description: Practice talking about what you like and dislike doing in your free time.

DayMission.description: Learn German vocabulary for weather, seasons, temperature, and conditions.

NightMission.description: Practice describing today's weather and discussing the forecast.

DayMission.description: Learn German vocabulary for common jobs, workplaces, and professional activities.

NightMission.description: Practice describing your job, workplace, and daily work activities.

DayMission.description: Learn der, die, das and understand basic German noun genders.

NightMission.description: Practice using German articles correctly with common nouns.

DayMission.description: Learn the basic accusative case and how articles change after certain verbs.

NightMission.description: Practice building simple sentences using the accusative case.

DayMission.description: Learn können, müssen, wollen, sollen, dürfen, and mögen.

NightMission.description: Practice talking about what you can, must, want, and should do.

DayMission.description: Learn common separable verbs and understand how they work in German sentences.

NightMission.description: Practice using separable verbs in everyday conversations.

DayMission.description: Learn the basic dative case and common verbs that require dative objects.

NightMission.description: Practice using dative articles and pronouns in simple sentences.

DayMission.description: Learn common reflexive verbs and how to use reflexive pronouns.

NightMission.description: Practice using reflexive verbs to describe everyday activities.

DayMission.description: Learn the basics of the German Perfekt tense for talking about past events.

NightMission.description: Practice describing things you did yesterday using the Perfekt tense.

DayMission.description: Learn German vocabulary for trains, buses, airports, tickets, and travel.

NightMission.description: Practice buying tickets, asking about transport, and discussing travel plans.

DayMission.description: Learn German vocabulary for body parts, common symptoms, and basic health situations.

NightMission.description: Practice explaining simple symptoms and communicating with a doctor in German.

DayMission.description: Learn how to compare people, objects, places, and experiences in German.

NightMission.description: Practice using comparative and superlative forms in everyday sentences.

DayMission.description: Learn common German conjunctions such as und, aber, oder, denn, and weil.

NightMission.description: Practice combining ideas and building longer German sentences.

DayMission.description: Learn basic subordinate clauses and understand verb position after weil and dass.

NightMission.description: Practice explaining reasons and opinions using weil and dass.

DayMission.description: Learn useful expressions for giving opinions, agreeing, disagreeing, and expressing preferences.

NightMission.description: Practice expressing and defending simple opinions in German.

DayMission.description: Practice German expressions used in common everyday situations.

NightMission.description: Complete several short conversations using vocabulary and grammar from previous days.

DayMission.description: Review important vocabulary, grammar, sentence structures, and expressions from the previous 28 days.

NightMission.description: Test your vocabulary, grammar, reading, and pronunciation skills with a mixed challenge.

DayMission.description: Complete a final challenge covering the most important German skills learned throughout the journey.

NightMission.description: Complete a full German conversation using greetings, personal information, family, food, travel, work, grammar, opinions, and everyday expressions.
